notes.title: Kickstarter Preview
notes.notes:
Hello Space Explorers,

We're incredibly excited to announce that the Kickstarter holding page for Pixel Starships 2 is now available! You can follow it here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/savysoda/pixel-starships-2?ref=735scu]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/savysoda/pixel-starships-2?ref=735scu[/url]

To continue the monumental success and widespread acclaim of the Pixel Starships franchise, we've been working tirelessly to bring you a new engine that takes the space exploration, strategic gameplay, and community interaction to new cosmic heights.

We believe in the power of community and we know that the success of Pixel Starships was built upon the support and feedback of our incredible player base. That’s why we're inviting you to join us on this journey.

Visit our Kickstarter page now and get notified of what's to come. Whether you're a seasoned captain or a starry-eyed recruit, we need your help to make Pixel Starships 2 a reality. Let's navigate the cosmos together, pushing the boundaries of mobile gaming even further into the unknown.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Remember, in the vast expanse of space, we are stronger together!

Blast off to our Kickstarter page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/savysoda/pixel-starships-2?ref=735scu]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/savysoda/pixel-starships-2?ref=735scu[/url]

See you amongst the stars,

The Pixel Starships 2 Team
